notes.title: Isles of Silence - Out Now!
notes.content:
After many long years of starting projects, toying with different mediums, and graduating university, it's finally time to actually see a project through to the end. I'm proud to announce:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3009460/Isles_of_Silence][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32599312/e63ae6d4d13bffd4e676dbcf8c438dca2d169c6d.png[/img][/url]

Set on a series of islands in the middle of the ocean, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3009460/Isles_of_Silence]Isles of Silence[/url] sees you managing an ever-growing group of survivors as they fight to secure a place for themselves in their ill-fated land. The entire planet has been shaken by an unprecedented calamity, and the very land itself is growing hostile to your presence. Uncover the past and preserve your future as you lead your group to a better life, being careful to not upset whatever forces seem intent on stopping you.

[b]With that being said,[/b] if you're reading this very specific news article, it means you came here from 'Katie' and enjoyed that game enough to check out this next one. 'Isles of Silence' is a very different game to 'Katie', being an incremental resource-management game instead of a walking-sim. However, while 'Katie' was my first project, I feel it still represents what I love most in games and what I want to make, and I look back on it fondly. 'Isles' will hopefully retain a lot of that narrative charm and mystery that was inherent to 'Katie', as every new feature comes with an NPC complete with a backstory and oodles of dialogue to both inform and add flavor, complementing an ever-evolving story as you progress through the game. 'Isles' seeks to continue the worldbuilding that Katie's secret ending touched on (for those that found it), but will mostly be entirely new territory that I'm incredibly excited to share with you all!

I hope you guys check it out when it launches, and thank you so much for playing what I made!
And, if any of this sounds interesting, a wishlist goes a long way in helping the game get seen :)

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3009460/Isles_of_Silence]Game link here[/url] [/h1]

notes.title: Katie's 1 Year Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
[h1]It's been one year since the launch of Katie![/h1]

And my word, what a ride it has been!
Thank you once again to everyone who played my game! Thanks for the reviews, the emails, the community works, thanks for it all! To celebrate the occasion, I've added a small little new content update for those who have the Gratitude Pack or Extra Cool Edition (due to it requiring the soundtrack files).

[b]Introducing Quiet Mode:[/b]
If you've beaten the game and own the soundtrack, a new icon will appear on your menu! This icon will take you to the Saturday night scene, except with no dialogue. By default, the little red speaker will now be playing the soundtrack, but if you drag your own .ogg or .wav files into the new 'Custom Songs' folder, you can now chill out to your own personal playlist! 

I hope some of you find use for it, as it's been an idea I've been toying with for awhile, mainly as a sort of virtual de-stresser with no pressure involved. And yes, it works for VR!

Things to note:
[list]
[*] The Custom Songs folder be found in the game's install directory after running it once
[*] Unfortunately, only .wav and .ogg are supported, due to limitations in the engine. If requested, there's possibility others could be added in the future.
[*] The Katie OST now contains a folder with all the songs in .ogg format :]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32599312/8afb51373654b48148fccb9cec7fc9de860a484f.png[/img]

As well as the new content, I've finally gotten around enhancing to the VR movement system and fixing some major bugs! (And hopefully not adding too many new ones)
[u]Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] The swing no longer changes your size *MAJOR FIX* (took me long enough)
[*] VR audio was flipped left to right so I flipped it back. I think it's right this time.
[*]There was a small weird white plane outside the school? Anyways, it's gone now.
[*]VR teleportation is now less of a toss-up on where you'll actually end up
[/list]

[u]VR Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*] You can now turn by pressing left and right on the thumb-pad of the left-hand!
[*] You can now point to the menu buttons, instead of physically touching them!
[*] Teleportation range has been vastly shortened, so you aren't constantly ending up out of bounds across the map. :b
[/list]

Hope you all are having a great day! Thanks for an awesome year!
     - Josiah

notes.title: DISTANCE Update done! Katie is complete!
notes.content:
[h1] The Final Update is here! [/h1]

Or, at least, the final planned update.

I teased this many months ago, and it's finally finished! The Distance update adds in some final secret post-game content. To begin the hunt for this chapter, simply finish the game! For those who have already beaten it, simply reaching the credits should allow you to begin the search. 

I'm quite happy with the weird little thing I made here, and hope you guys enjoy it! It's... a bit of a different tone, but one I wholly enjoyed making!

[h1] Thank you so much to everyone who played my game! It means the world, and I hope to be able to bring new experiences to each of you going forward! [/h1]

notes.title: First Official Patch! (June 13, 2018)
notes.content:
Long time, no see!

To prep for the big, free, and upcoming 'SECRETS UPDATE', I wanted to patch a few issues that I have noticed, and some pointed out to me by the community. I know it sounds kinda lame, but this is my first official 'patch notes', and I'm kinda psyched. So without further ado:

Fixes:
[list][*] Ideas (aka: citizens) no longer can be talked to through walls
[*] You can no longer get stuck on the dock on Thursday
[*] Rainclouds now always appear and disappear when they should
[*] Ideas no longer get stuck by the swingset
[*] Fixed a visual issue near the clifftops
[*] Katie should no longer fail to talk at times if you stay in her vicinity
[*] Katie sits properly on her log on the final day
[*] Changed an "it's" to an "its" (MAJOR)
[*] Katie won't stop and 'wait for the player' if the player is ahead of her
[*] probably some other stuff
[/list]

Thank you for all who purchased and played my game! It means the world ~
New, extra content is coming this summer!

Also:
I heard some of you liked the soundtrack! If you haven't purchased the Gratitude Pack, the full soundtrack is now up on Youtube for you to have a listen - https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLIPzdTXk8ekNowIK48tkVSexQwXFtqvQU
